enchantment.sustainedfire.cooling_device: Reduces heat per shot by 10% per level. At level 10, the gun never overheats.
enchantment.sustainedfire.air_cooling.de: Faster-firing guns build less heat per shot; at high RPM, shooting actively cools the barrel.
enchantment.sustainedfire.belt_feed.desc: Fires directly from inventory ammo (including backpacks and ammo crates). No reloading needed. Treasure enchantment.
enchantment.sustainedfire.preheat.desc: The hotter the barrel, the faster it fires: up to +40% RPM per level at full heat.
enchantment.sustainedfire.progressive_tr: Fire rate ramps up while firing continuously: +15% RPM per level after 3 seconds of sustained fire.
